items.t: Micron Is Down 32% in a Month. Can MU Stock Get Back to $1,000?
items.sum: A 12% single-day plunge has wiped out billions in Micron's value just as UBS questions whether AI spending can ever pay for itself. The memory giant's bulls have committed shipments on their side, but one upcoming test could decide everything.

items.t: Micron’s President Says “We Can’t Support Every Customer.” Apple Just Locked In Samsung’s DRAM
items.sum: Key TakeawaysMicron’s president said the company “can’t support every customer,” as Apple reportedly nears a Samsung DRAM deal with the price left open. In a memory shortage that Micron says runs for years, suppliers hold the leverage, which helps explain Micron’s 80.

items.t: Micron Stock Plunges 13% as Barron’s Calls Memory Stocks ‘Agonizingly Cheap’; Western Digital, SanDisk and Seagate Sink in AI Chip Selloff
items.sum: Micron fell 13% on Friday and sits 50% below its June record as Barron's calls memory stocks "agonizingly cheap." The stock's last two busts ended after drops of 50% and 54%. Here is the case for and against.

items.t: Prediction: This Is What Will Happen to Micron’s Stock Price in December
items.sum: The memory specialist has taken a beating in recent months, but it could get a nice shot in the arm when it releases its quarterly results next month.

items.t: Micron Stocks Fall 2.10% After 7.8% Anthropic Rally Reverses
items.sum: Micron joined Anthropic's $26 billion placement and supplies its memory, but the AI selloff erased a $760 intraday high.

items.t: Stock Market Midday, Nov. 20: Nasdaq Plunges Nearly 3% as AMD and Micron Lead a Brutal Semiconductor Sell-Off
items.sum: Mounting regulatory concerns, elevated valuations, and uncertainty surrounding interest rates are putting some of Wall Street's biggest winners of the AI boom under considerable pressure.
